title: AI Functions Asynchronous API (Beta)
body:
You can now use the AI Functions Asynchronous API to run `ai_parse_document`, `ai_extract`, or `ai_classify` asynchronously on up to 50,000 requests from a JSONL file in a Unity Catalog volume. The batch writes one result for each request to a file in a volume. Workspace admins can turn on the **AI Functions Asynchronous API** preview from the [**Previews** page](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews). This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types).

See the [Asynchronous API reference](https://docs.databricks.com/api/ai-functions/v1/batch). For examples, see [document parsing](/aws/en/agents/agent-bricks/document-parsing#asynchronous-api), [information extraction](/aws/en/agents/agent-bricks/info-extraction#asynchronous-api), and [classification](/aws/en/agents/agent-bricks/classification#asynchronous-api).
